subject: xxhash can be inlined even if it was previously included
perf_evidence: Commit adds a second-include inline-all mode so callers can inline fixed-size hash functions after a prior header include.
change_summary: Reworks XXH_INLINE_ALL header reinclusion and symbol names, enabling a build configuration that previously failed.

units.name: target double include without XXH_STATIC_LINKING_ONLY
units.evidence: The old header fails to compile when included normally and then with XXH_INLINE_ALL; no old LLVM program exists for the newly enabled build mode.

units.name: public fixed-size hash cases in previously supported single/double-include modes
units.evidence: Six single-include public targets and four double-include static-linking-only public targets pass bidirectional Alive2.

notes: Existing build configurations have checked fixed-size output behavior; the performance-relevant newly enabled include sequence has no pre-commit counterpart.
